title: سيميوني يتحدى برشلونة بتصريح جريء.. ويتهرب من سؤال الكلاسيكو
summary: هل يحفزك عدم اعتبار أتلتيكو ضمن المرشحين للفوز بلقب الليجا؟
body: هل يحفزك عدم اعتبار أتلتيكو ضمن المرشحين للفوز بلقب الليجا؟ قيّم مدرب أتلتيكو مدريد، دييجو سيميوني، الوضع الحالي لفريقه، كما تحدث عن المباراة التي تنتظره أمام ديبورتيفو لاكورونيا، غدا السبت، في الجولة العاشرة من الليجا. ونشرت صحيفة آس ، تصريحات سيميوني خلال المؤتمر الصحفي التقديمي، حيث قال "الخصم يقدم مستويات جيدة في جميع مبارياته؛ فقد فاز في بعضها، وتمكن من التعادل في أخرى، وخسر أيضًا". وتابع "ديبورتيفو لاكورونيا فريق جريء. سبق أن واجهناه في النسخة الماضية من كأس ملك إسبانيا، وقد عانينا كثيرًا أمامه". ولفت المدرب الأرجنتيني "كيف ستتابع الكلاسيكو؟ أفكر فقط في مباراة ديبورتيفو لاكورونيا". وشدد "هل من الممكن منافسة برشلونة بهذا المستوى؟ نعم، بالطبع، يمكن المنافسة دائمًا. الأمر واضح تمامًا، وقد ثبت ذلك. لكن هذا لا يغير حقيقة أن برشلونة يمتلك فريقًا رائعًا". وزاد "هل يحفزك عدم اعتبار أتلتيكو ضمن المرشحين للفوز باللقب؟ أعتذر منك، لكنني لا أفكر إلا في ديبورتيفو". وقال "كيف حال باريوس؟ وهل أصبح قادرًا على اللعب لمدة 90 دقيقة؟ الأهم هو أن يقدم مستوى جيدًا خلال الدقائق التي يشارك فيها، مثلما يفعل في الفترة الأخيرة". وأوضح "ما شعورك عندما ترى خيمينيز منافسًا لك؟ في البداية، لا أستطيع أن أفصله عن الفريق الذي سيواجهنا، ولا عن الشخص والرجل الذي ساعدني ورافقني بفضل التزامه الكبير. أنا ممتن لخوس…

summary: موقف نجم برشلونة يزداد تعقيدًا قبل الكلاسيكو

title: روما يسعى لفك العقدة ضد نابولي.. وأليجري يخشى مصير دونادوني
summary: مؤشرات تحذر أصحاب الأرض
body: مؤشرات تحذر أصحاب الأرض يلتقي نابولي مع روما ، غدا السبت، في الجولة الثامنة من الدوري الإيطالي، وسط أرقام وإحصائيات لافتة تتعلق بمواجهات الفريقين السابقة، إلى جانب عدد من المؤشرات الفردية للاعبين. ووفقا لشبكة "أوبتا" المتخصصة في الإحصائيات، تعادل نابولي مع روما في 55 مباراة بالدوري الإيطالي، مقابل 50 فوزا و53 هزيمة، ولم يسجل نابولي عددا أكبر من التعادلات في تاريخه بالدرجة الأولى إلا أمام تورينو، بواقع 56 تعادلا. ولم يتعرض نابولي للهزيمة في آخر 8 مباريات خاضها على أرضه أمام روما بالدوري الإيطالي، محققا 4 انتصارات و4 تعادلات. ولم يحقق الفريق سلسلة أطول من المباريات دون خسارة على ملعبه أمام روما في المسابقة منذ الفترة بين عامي 1971 و1982، عندما خاض 11 مباراة متتالية دون هزيمة، بواقع 10 انتصارات وتعادل واحد. ومنذ اعتماد نظام احتساب 3 نقاط للفوز في موسم 1994-1995، لم يحقق أي فريق انتصارات خارج أرضه على نابولي بالدوري الإيطالي أكثر من أتالانتا، الذي يملك 8 انتصارات، بينما حقق روما 7 انتصارات، وهو العدد نفسه الذي سجلته فيورنتينا ويوفنتوس ولاتسيو. ومع ذلك، لم يحقق روما أي فوز في الدوري على ملعب نابولي منذ مارس 2018، حين انتصر بنتيجة 4-2. وخسر نابولي 3 من أول 7 مباريات خاضها في الدوري الإيطالي هذا الموسم، مقابل 3 انتصارات وتعادل واحد. وكانت المرة الأخيرة التي تعرض فيها الفريق لـ3 هزائم على…

title: رقم مثير يدعم جدار بونو أمام إعصار القادسية

title: Your Pixel might be recording something completely different from what you see
summary: The viewfinder says you've nailed it. The saved footage disagrees.
body: TL;DR A Pixel 11 video bug causes moving subjects to disappear from saved recordings despite remaining visible in the camera viewfinder. Similar complaints date back to the Pixel 6 Pro, with video stabilization and lens switching among the suspected culprits. We reproduced similar behavior on our Pixel 9 Pro XL, but our Galaxy S26 FE showed no comparable issue during testing. How do you beat the iPhone at video recording when your camera can’t even keep the subject in the shot? That’s an awkward question for Google, whose Pixel phones have earned plenty of praise for photography but haven’t quite shaken the iPhone’s reputation as the safer bet for video. A bizarre Pixel 11 glitch is putting that weakness in the spotlight, with moving subjects appearing fine in the viewfinder but disappearing from the saved footage. The real kicker? Older Pixels have been caught pulling similar disappearing acts. The latest example comes from a Pixel 11 owner on Reddit , whose screen recording shows them following a pedestrian at 18x zoom. title: Pixels and Galaxies aside, these are the phones that are worth your money
summary: Options are scarce, but some are worth your time and money.
body: Amazon’s top-selling smartphones list reveals how dominant Apple’s iPhones and Samsung’s Galaxy phones are in the US. It’s not necessarily because they’re the best smartphones year after year. It’s mostly due to the lack of choices consumers have in North America. OnePlus’s recent exit from the North American and European markets is a modern-day tech tragedy. Losing one of the best Android manufacturers is a huge blow to both fans of the company and consumers who need more options in the US. Americans who want a new Android phone are now limited to a handful of brands.

title: This app lets you run Steam games on Android, and it now supports Game Pass too
summary: Expect support for your Itch.io library too.
body: Credit: Hadlee Simons / Android Authority TL;DR DroidDeck now offers experimental support for Xbox and PC Game Pass, allowing you to run these games on Android. The app has also gained support for the Itch.io storefront, further expanding the number of PC games you can run on your mobile device. Other improvements include touchscreen gestures, faster performance on Adreno GPUs, and faster loading from microSD cards. DroidDeck has quickly become one of the most impressive gaming apps on Android. The app lets you locally run PC games on your device, while also offering a SteamOS-like experience. The team behind this app has just released an update that brings major additions and fixes. DroidDeck v0.6.0 has just been released on GitHub, and it now offers experimental support for Xbox and PC Game Pass. The developers say you can sign in via your Microsoft account to view your owned games as well as Game Pass titles. You can then download and play these games using Proton or FEX, much like your Steam titles.

title: Google is tackling three Googlebook headaches before they become migraines
summary: The honeymoon isn't entirely smooth, but at least Google is listening.
body: TL;DR Google is working on fixes for several early Googlebook issues affecting Bluetooth audio, AI Writing Tools, and phone app casting. Bluetooth improvements include a latency fix and expanded audio codec support, while separate fixes are being developed for the other two problems. Google hasn’t announced rollout dates, though some users say their Writing Tools issues are already resolved. A new computer, a new operating system, and a whole new way of getting things done. Googlebooks have plenty for early adopters to get used to, and the occasional learning curve is hardly surprising . But some owners are running into problems that can’t be solved simply by learning their way around the interface. Fortunately, Google is listening, with several fixes already in development for issues affecting Bluetooth audio, AI writing tools , and phone app casting. Over on Reddit, Google’s Mishaal Rahman has been actively engaging with affected users, gathering feedback, and checking with the product team. His latest responses shed light on what the team is doing about these frustrating problems.

title: Nintendo Switch 2 jailbreak discovery could open the door to a world of mods
summary: An obscure game has provided an unlikely route into Nintendo's latest console.
body: Credit: Pepsipu.com TL;DR A developer has released a software-only Nintendo Switch 2 jailbreak that works on the latest firmware. The exploit uses vulnerabilities involving SmileBASIC 4 and has already been demonstrated with Mario Kart World mods. The jailbreak isn’t permanent and doesn’t yet provide full control over the console. Unsurprisingly, Nintendo hasn’t exactly made life easy for anyone hoping to tinker with the Switch 2 beyond its intended limits. But one developer has now made a significant breakthrough, releasing a software-only Switch 2 jailbreak that works even on the console’s latest firmware. Security researcher Sammy Hajhamid, who goes by pepsipu online, announced the achievement on X and explained how it works in a detailed blog post . The exploit, called ns2jb, works on firmware version 23.0.1 without requiring any physical modifications to the console. There are caveats, but the jailbreak may open the door to things like unofficial software and game modifications.

title: Some Android phones and Google Calendar events could soon be an hour off
summary: Android users in parts of Canada should check their phones before November 1.
body: TL;DR Parts of Canada are switching to permanent daylight saving time on November 1, ending seasonal clock changes. Google warns that Android phones running outdated software could incorrectly turn their clocks back by an hour. Some Google Calendar events could also shift by an hour, with certain appointments requiring manual corrections through the web version. The biannual tradition of changing clocks is coming to an end for a subset of the Canadian population, though with that convenience comes an added side of initial headaches. Permanent daylight saving time for British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, and the Northwest Territories starts on November 1, and with the date just a little over a week away at this point, Google wants to help Android users in those regions — or anyone traveling through them — make the transition. If the new rule hadn’t gone into effect, clocks in those regions would automatically turn back by an hour. Starting November 1, however, that won’t happen. While that sounds like a seamless transition, there’s a big catch here, especially for users who haven’t updated their Android devices.

summary: The feature detects and translates 63 languages.
body: TL;DR Google Meet just added Gemini-powered speech translation across 63 languages. The feature automatically detects spoken languages and translates them in audio and captions for individual participants. Real-time translation starts rolling out to some eligible users today. Meetings are meant to facilitate communication, but anyone who’s been in one that could have been an email, as the saying goes, knows that’s not always the case. That’s even more true for teams with multilingual members. Now Google Meet has a solution with Gemini-powered speech translation for 63 languages on web and mobile devices. In a new Workspace blog entry , Google shares that Meet users will be able to turn on speech translation for themselves in their preferred language at any point in a meeting using a dedicated translation control in the meeting toolbar. Google Meet will then automatically detect what language is being spoken and translate it for the user, both audibly and in captions. Google claims this translation takes place in “near real-time.”

title: 1Password’s new solution mitigates the security risks of AI agent account access
summary: 1Password just made giving your AI agent account access a little safer.
body: Credit: 1Password TL;DR 1Password has created a way for AI agents to use your passwords without actually seeing them. When an agent reaches a login screen, 1Password for Agents will autofill the password or one-time code so the agent can’t see or take possession of your credentials. It will work with a range of AI agents, such as Muse and Grok, with more to come later. You may trust an AI agent to help with your work, but you probably draw the line at letting it access your passwords. While understandable, that choice can also act as an obstacle when an AI agent needs access to an account. 1Password aims to solve the security risks of AI agent account access with its new solution. The digital vault and password manager company has announced 1Password for Agents. This new platform is designed to let AI agents use your passwords without letting the agent actually see or take possession of them. You’ll be able to connect it with Facebook’s Muse and SpaceX Super Intelligence’s Grok bot. More agent connections are expected to be on the way, including Claude Duet, ChatGPT Work and dots, Perplexity, and more.

body: TL;DR YouTube users recently started reporting that they were finding their dislike button hidden away. Google now confirms that this change only appears for your own uploaded videos.
